claude.result:
Awaiting approval to commit the refactoring.

**Summary of Refactoring Complete:**

**New Module Created:**
- `src/totals.js` - Focused module for invoice amount calculations
  - Exports: lineTotal, lineDiscount, lineVAT, invoiceTotals
  - Dependencies: ./result.js (ok, fail), ./money.js (roundCents)
  - Handles all per-line and invoice-level total calculations

**Updated Files:**
- `src/invoices.js` - Reduced from ~370 lines to ~270 lines
  - Imports totals functions from src/totals.js
  - Re-exports them for backward compatibility
  - All existing imports continue to work without changes
  - Removed duplicate function definitions

**Test Coverage:**
- `test/totals.test.js` - New comprehensive test file with 27 tests
  - Tests lineTotal (qty × unitPrice calculations)
  - Tests lineDiscount (discount percentage application)
  - Tests lineVAT (VAT calculations with and without discounts)
  - Tests invoiceTotals (multi-line aggregation, voucher integration)
  - Error handling (invalid inputs, null/undefined)
  - Edge cases (zero amounts, empty lines, decimal discounts)

**Benefits:**
- Reduced invoices.js complexity and cognitive load
- Totals module is now independently testable
- Better code organization and separation of concerns
- All 372 tests passing (all existing tests + 27 new tests)
- Backward compatibility maintained - no breaking changes

**Files Modified:**
- Created `src/totals.js` - 104 lines
- Updated `src/invoices.js` - removed ~110 lines of function definitions, added imports
- Created `test/totals.test.js` - 276 lines with 27 comprehensive tests
